# cccc-willbooster-tree-sitter

[WillBooster's fork of the tree-sitter runtime](https://github.com/WillBooster/tree-sitter)
(`willbooster-tree-sitter` 23.1.0), repackaged for
[cccc](https://github.com/moznion/cccc).

`willbooster-tree-sitter-c-sharp` 3.0.0 and later only load in this fork, while
every other cccc grammar needs upstream `tree-sitter`. Upstream and the fork
both claim `links = "tree-sitter"` and define the same C symbols, so they
cannot be linked into one binary as published. This crate is the fork with:

- its own crate name and `links` value;
- every global C symbol renamed to `cccc_wb_<symbol>` (see `symbols.txt`),
  with matching `#[link_name]`s on the Rust side;
- the `wasm` and `bindgen` features removed.

The Rust API is the fork's, unchanged; its library name is still `tree_sitter`.
It is generated by `.github/scripts/vendor-willbooster-tree-sitter.sh` in the
cccc repository. It is not meant for use outside cccc.

Licensed under MIT, as upstream (see `LICENSE`).
